text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates several objects in the same image. These technologies have many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect pedestrians and other vehicles. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and face unlock on smartphones.
